node.doctext:
may be this is the reason I am not getting any replies

The best way to get fast, high-quality replies is to post a high-quality question. If you provide:

  • short but runnable code that reproduces the problem,
  • example input,
  • expected output for the sample input, and
  • output you're actually getting, including any error messages

then you will likely get replies quickly.

This is explained in more detail in [id://174051], [id://1177642], and [id://510718]
